title: Highlight callout · icon + copy
description: Cost, coverage or “what happens next” notes that must not be missed. One per email.
usage: Yellow callout card for a cost / coverage message. Icon is locked to the brand icon set. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Transparent PNG: white 75px circle with the Abbott icon (No Budget Burden) centred at ~46x44. Composite of Figma node 99:1432. Decorative, alt="".

notes: The icon circle is hard-coded white in Figma (baked into the PNG).
The icon stays to the right of the copy on mobile, as in the Mobile frame.
Mobile: callout padding is mobPad16 (exact); panel padding snaps to 10 top / 15 sides (padd-none, pad15), bottom stays 16 (Figma 8).
Copy-to-icon gap is a 16px spacer cell that drops to 10px on mobile (bw10; Figma 8).
